test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held on: 14 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

Do you know the old __adage__ 'the show must go on’?
solution:
The correct answer is "**Misconstruction.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The question asks for an antonym of the underlined word.
 
• The underlined word is '**adage.**'
 
• **"Adage" means a saying that sets forth a general truth and that has gained credit through long use (**एक पुरानी और प्रसिद्ध कहावत जो एक आम सच्चाई को व्यक्त करती है।)**.**
 
 
• Example: He remembered the old adage, "Look before you leap."
 
 
 
• **The word "misconstruction" means a false interpretation of evidence , facts, etc**.
 
 
• Example: Any misconstruction of these terms could lead to errors of law.
 
 
 
• Thus, it can be concluded that the word "misconstruction" is the antonym of the word "adage."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Rebuke** means to scold or criticize someone.
 
• **Dare** means to challenge someone to do something risky or difficult.
 
• **Addiction** means a strong dependence on a substance or activity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• Misconstruction: ग़लतफ़हमी
 
• Rebuke: फटकार
 
• Dare: हिम्मत
 
• Addiction: लत
